map.输入工件长度、材料、切削速度和切深，计算刨削行程、往复次数与加工时间: Input workpiece length, material, cutting speed and depth of cut to compute planing stroke, reciprocation count and machining time
map.📖 查看「刨削参数匹配 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Planing Parameter Matching User Guide"
map.💡 行程长度 = 工件长度 + 2×越程量；刨削时间 = 行程数 × 行程长度: 💡 Stroke length = workpiece length + 2×overrun; planing time = stroke count × stroke length / cutting speed.
map.刨削为断续切削，实际需考虑冲击、回程时间等: Planing is intermittent cutting; in practice consider impact, return time, etc.
map.📚 深度解析：切削行程与时间计算: 📚 In-depth: Cutting Stroke and Time Calculation
map.批量生产排产与节拍核算。: Batch production scheduling and takt-time accounting.
map.优化进给降低总工时。: Optimize feed to reduce total work time.
map.工件长 L=200mm、越程 20mm、单刀往复 1 次：行程 H = 200+: Workpiece length L=200mm, overrun 20mm, single-pass reciprocation 1 time: stroke H = 200+2×20 = 240mm; vc=30m/min: T = 240÷(30×1000) ≈ 0.008min/stroke; schedule 100 pieces accordingly.
map.若 vc 提到 60m/min：T 减半，100 件总切削时间由约 0.8min: If vc is raised to 60m/min: T is halved, total cutting time for 100 pieces drops from about 0.8min to 0.4min, takt time improves significantly (excluding clamping).
map.刀具进出工件需安全距离防止啃刀与冲击，两端各加越程（一般 5–20mm），计入总: The tool needs a safe distance to enter and exit the workpiece to prevent gouging and impact; add overrun at both ends (generally 5-20mm), included in total stroke for accuracy.
map.不含，仅纯切削行程时间；排产需叠加装夹、测量、换刀等辅助时间得单件总工时。: No, only pure cutting-stroke time; scheduling must add auxiliary time such as clamping, measuring and tool change to get single-piece total work time.
map.刨削参数匹配工具，根据工件长度、材料、切削速度、切深和进给量，计算行程长度、走刀: The planing-parameter matching tool computes stroke length, pass count, total reciprocation count and cutting time from workpiece length, material, cutting speed, depth of cut and feed.
map.刨削行程与切削时间（本页代码口径，非「速度=行程÷时间」）：行程长度 H = L: Planing stroke and cutting time (code basis of this page, not "speed = stroke ÷ time"): stroke length H = L + 2× overtravel (mm, one overtravel at each end of the workpiece); number of passes = ceil(machining allowance ÷ depth of cut); reciprocating feeds per pass = ceil(L ÷ feed rate); total reciprocations = number of passes × reciprocating feeds per pass; cutting time T = total reciprocations × H ÷ (V_c×1000) (min, V_c in m/min, H in mm); material removal ≈ L × allowance × depth of cut × 0.001 (cm³, simplified). Validation: L, V_c, depth of cut, feed, allowance and overtravel must each be valid positive numbers; otherwise report an error per field and stop. Criterion: T >60 min suggests increasing cutting speed or feed rate.
